test_non_empty_xml_output: test that Google Test generates non-empty XML output matching the expected structure for all test cases
test_no_test_xml_output: test that Google Test generates valid XML output for a binary with no actual test cases
test_timestamp_value: test that the timestamp attribute in Google Test XML output is a valid ISO datetime string
test_default_output_file: test that Google Test creates an XML file with the default name test_detail.xml when no filename is specified
test_filtered_test_xml_output: test that Google Test XML output includes only tests matching the gtest_filter flag pattern
